title: VooPoo Uforce-X Replacement Glass 2ml
description: The VooPoo Uforce-X Tank Replacement Straight Glass is a high-quality, durable glass designed specifically for the Uforce-X Tank. This straight glass has a 2ml e-liquid capacity, compliant with TPD regulations, and is made from medical-grade Pyrex borosilicate material. The glass is engineered to withstand high temperatures and resist corrosion, ensuring a long-lasting and reliable vaping experience. The transparent design allows for easy monitoring of e-liquid levels, so you can see when it’s time for a refill. This replacement glass is an essential accessory for vapers who want to ensure their Uforce-X Tank is always in perfect working condition. Whether you need to replace a broken glass or just want a spare on hand, this straight glass is the perfect solution.
